svg.title: Cell
svg.desc: General eukaryotic cell with plasma membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondria, ER, and Golgi. Biological basis: A eukaryotic cell is compartmentalized by membrane-bound organelles that separate genome maintenance, biosynthesis, trafficking, and energy production.
